checks: No Biome errors or formatting drift

automated.title: Type boundaries across workspaces
checks: All TypeScript workspaces typecheck

automated.title: ImageDocument operations and text-instruction transactions
checks: Original asset references remain unchanged by composition edits
Crop, mask and framing preserve non-destructive undo and redo
Text instructions commit atomically and reject unsupported edits

automated.title: Production build
checks: API and web production builds complete

automated.title: Tenant-scoped immutable original assets
checks: Cross-tenant reads fail
Original bytes and hash remain intact
Idempotent and concurrent writes do not overwrite originals

automated.title: Versioned ImageDocument persistence
checks: Version conflict rejects stale saves
Historical versions remain immutable
Wrong-workspace assets and reads are rejected

automated.title: JWT and database membership authorization
checks: Forged and expired tokens fail
Token role claims grant no access
Membership revocation and tenant boundaries take effect immediately

automated.title: Retry-safe local project import
checks: Failed import retries reuse assets
Original and mask references map to server IDs
Cross-tenant import records are isolated

automated.title: Conservative orphan-object cleanup
checks: Dry-run changes nothing
Recent and referenced objects are retained
Only old unreferenced test objects are conditionally deleted

automated.title: Authenticated Image Studio project HTTP workflow
checks: Unauthenticated uploads and cross-workspace reads fail before file handling
Oversized multipart requests are rejected before file buffering
Import replay preserves source bytes and asset identity
Incremental asset upload is idempotent; stale saves conflict; revocation takes effect

automated.title: Real Keycloak token and JWKS development flow
checks: Real issuer and audience token verifies against JWKS
Database membership grants and revocation are enforced

automated.title: Real Keycloak token through project HTTP authorization
checks: Anonymous project list receives 401
Public browser client enforces PKCE and permits only the development origin
Real Keycloak token with database membership reads the development workspace

automated.title: Real second-account workspace isolation
checks: An authenticated Keycloak user with no membership receives 403 on project list
The same user cannot read an existing project by ID

automated.title: Image QA intake and source integrity
checks: Original checksum changes invalidate review
Missing rights and outputs block acceptance
Review case identity cannot be swapped

manual.title: Text-instruction preview and single-step undo
manual.fixture: Synthetic product image with one image layer
steps: Enter: 改成竖图；背景改成浅灰色；把商品移到右边；添加标题：新品上市
Inspect preview before applying
Apply and undo once
Try: 把商品换成另一款
passCriteria: Preview shows all four operations
One undo restores the whole prior document
Unsupported product replacement changes nothing

manual.title: OIDC login and cloud Image Studio round trip
manual.fixture: Development Keycloak public client, workspace and owned PNG image
steps: Log in using authorization code and PKCE
Import a local project into the cloud workspace
Edit text, add a new image or mask and save another version
Reload the page, log in again and reopen the cloud project
passCriteria: The project and both original files load after reload
The edited version and mask are preserved
No token, original bytes or cross-workspace data appear in another account

manual.title: Shared-browser local draft account boundary
manual.fixture: Two development Keycloak users sharing one browser profile and a saved local image project
steps: Save an image project locally while using the first account
End the identity-service session and log in as the second account in the same browser profile
Inspect the local project list and try opening the first account's draft
passCriteria: The second account cannot see the first account's local project or original bytes
Any migration of existing local drafts preserves them for the original owner
